svg.title: Bike-share trips pile up downtown, thin out at the edges
svg.desc: Hexbin density map: the coastal-metro service area is tiled with 164 regular hexagons, each shaded by the number of morning bike-share trips that started inside it, from 3,200 trips in all. The single-hue blue ramp runs from pale (few trips) to deep blue (the busiest cell, 116 trips). Trips concentrate in the downtown core and along the waterfront and fade toward the suburban edge.
svg.text: Bike-share demand clusters on the downtown core
Morning trips (7-10 AM) per hexagonal bin across the metro service area · one hex ≈ 400 m · illustrative
